meta_description: Pro Painters in Southampton offers professional interior and exterior painting, decorating, and refurbishment. Local, reliable, free quotes.
hero_subhead: Interior and exterior painting done right. Free quote, no mess, no fuss—we finish on time and on budget.
services_heading: Complete Painting & Decorating Services in Southampton
services_subhead: From a single room refresh to whole-house refurbishment, we handle every paint and decor project with care and precision.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Transform any room with expert wall painting, woodwork refinishing, and feature walls. We prep surfaces thoroughly and use premium paints for a finish that lasts.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Rendering
services.desc: Protect and refresh your home's outside with weather-resistant exterior paint, render repairs, and fascia work. We work in all seasons and leave your property weathertight.

services.title: Wallpaper Hanging & Removal
services.desc: Professional wallpapering for pattern, texture, or colour impact. We also remove old paper cleanly and prepare walls to a smooth finish.

services.title: Cabinet & Furniture Painting
services.desc: Revive tired kitchens and bathrooms with expert cabinet painting and refinishing. Durable, hard-wearing finishes that resist moisture and daily wear.

services.title: Commercial Decorating
services.desc: Office spaces, shops, and rental properties need reliable, deadline-driven work. We minimise disruption and maintain professional standards throughout.

services.title: Plastering & Prep Work
services.desc: We don't cut corners. Full surface preparation, minor plasterwork, and filling ensures a flawless finish before any paint goes on.

about_pullquote: We treat every home like it's our own—honest work, fair pricing, every time.
about_para_1: Pro Painters was founded on the belief that homeowners deserve straightforward, reliable decorating without inflated quotes or hidden costs. Over 15 years, we've built a reputation across Southampton by turning up on time, delivering on our promises, and leaving homes looking genuinely transformative. We're locals who understand the area and the importance of doing the job right first time.
about_para_2: Our customers return to us because we listen, give honest advice, and never oversell. Whether it's a single bedroom refresh or a whole commercial property, we bring the same level of care and attention to detail. We're fully insured, use quality paints and materials, and always leave the site clean and ready to use.
reviews_heading: What Southampton Homeowners Say About Pro Painters

reviews.text: Had our lounge completely redecorated—new wallpaper and fresh paint throughout. The team were brilliant, very tidy, and finished ahead of schedule. Came in at the quoted price with no surprises. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Margaret T.

reviews.text: Needed our kitchen cabinets painted and wasn't sure if it would work. The lads explained exactly how they'd do it and the result is fantastic. Looks brand new without the cost of a new kitchen. Top job.
reviews.author: David M.

reviews.text: Three bedrooms and hallway done in less than a week. No mess, no stress, and they sorted out some plasterwork as part of the job without charging extra. Would definitely use them again.
reviews.author: Susan K.
